ad_prob.comment: The probability for random adaption of values in evolutionary algorithms

adapt_ad_prob.comment: Determines the rate of adaption of ad_prob. Set to 0, if you do not need this feature

min_ad_prob.comment: The lower allowed boundary for ad_prob-variation

max_ad_prob.comment: The upper allowed boundary for ad_prob-variation

adaption_threshold.comment: of mutation parameters takes place (e.g sigma-variation in gauss mutation)

use_bi_gaussian.comment: Whether to use a double gaussion for the adaption of parmeters in ES

sigma1.comment: (or the sigma of the left peak of a double gaussian)

sigma_sigma1.comment: Influences the self-adaption of gauss-mutation in ES

sigma2.comment: The sigma of the right peak of a double gaussian (if any)

sigma_sigma2.comment: Influences the self-adaption of gauss-mutation in ES

delta.comment: The start distance between both peaks used for bi-gaussian mutations in ES

sigma_delta.comment: The width of the gaussian used for mutations of the delta parameter

min_delta.comment: The minimum allowed value of delta

max_delta.comment: The maximum allowed value of delta

par_dim.comment: The number of dimensions used for the demo function

min_var.comment: The lower boundary of the initialization range for parameters

max_var.comment: The upper boundary of the initialization range for parameters

parameter_type.comment: Selects the flat-genome structure, along two axes -- bounded-vs-unbounded and shared-vs-per-parameter adaptor group;(0) unbounded, one shared group;(1) bounded, one shared group;(2) unbounded, one group per parameter;(3) bounded, one group per parameter;

eval_policy.comment: 2 (a.k.a. USESIGMOID): Assign a multiple of validity_level_ and sigmoid barrier to invalid solutions, apply a sigmoid function to valid evaluations

steepness.comment: The parameter must have a value > 0.

barrier.comment: The parameter must have a value > 0.

maxmode.comment: Note that minimization is the by far most common option.
